instruction: Extend the existing Dashboard Destinations parent panel with up to three real ranked matched-country cards and a Visa Options preview for the #1 match. Add a dedicated dashboard_destination visual asset and admin generation workflow. Do not rebuild or refactor the Dashboard shell. Preserve Journey Tracker, Dashboard customization, matching/ranking/profile/plan logic, unrelated widgets, Your World, and existing PATHWAYS data. Add canonical design schema documentation in docs.
objective: Implement the approved Country Design System extension and Dashboard Destinations panel behavior: one existing Destinations widget containing top-3 nested matched-country cards, dedicated dashboard_destination imagery with manual admin generation/approval and no runtime generation, and a PATHWAYS-backed Visa Options preview beneath the grid.
allowedUIRegions: Country Page Generator Engine admin tabs and previews
requiredChanges: keep Destinations as one existing Dashboard parent widget and do not rebuild the Dashboard shell
show up to three real ranked matches only after profile completion
display rank and country name only on nested matched-country cards while retaining Match Score in accessibility text
add dashboard_destination to visual schemas, generator request types, approved storage, serving, and registry contracts without renaming existing hero or city persisted types
use a 1536x1024 Dashboard destination generation master with a default central 70 percent crop-safe zone
keep Dashboard destination generation admin-only, one image per request, and require explicit review/save approval
use dashboard_destination then committed dashboard asset then official flag then neutral fallback; never auto-substitute country hero, city image, or Mapbox snapshot
show up to three existing PATHWAYS entries for the number-one matched country beneath the matched-card grid
mark the existing destinations widget full-width using the existing widget registry so the nested grid has sufficient room
add docs/country-design-schema.md and align Country Design System and Dashboard Destinations documentation
forbiddenChanges: Dashboard shell redesign or navigation redesign
new Dashboard widgets for individual matched countries
Match Score calculation or ranking logic
Kolmari Plan state or destination decision state
Your World map or unrelated Mapbox components
